content: ECS Fargate task definitions require task-level cpu/memory from fixed size combinations; sum container reservations and round to nearest valid Fargate size. For Node.js (single-threaded), give headroom beyond the app thread for GC/I/O - e.g. 1-2 vCPU / 2-4GB observed as good starting point for small APIs; load test before finalizing. Avoid over-allocating CPU (underutilization, wasted cost).
